---
name: "nf-core/fasta_hmmsearch_rank_fastas"
description: "Run hmmsearch and output separate fasta files for top scoring hits to\
  \ each profile"
keywords:
- "hmmer"
- "search"
- "rank"
- "fasta"
components:
- "hmmer/hmmsearch"
- "hmmer/formattsv"
- "duckdb/table2parquet"
- "hmmer/hmmrank"
- "seqtk/subseq"
input:
- ch_hmms:
    type: "file"
    description: "The input channel containing hmm profiles\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(hmm) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{hmm}"
- ch_fasta:
    type: "file"
    description: "The input channel containing sequences to be searched and ranked\n"
- save_domtblout:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Whether hmmsearch should also write and emit its per-domain hit\
      \ table (--domtblout)\n"
output:
- hmmrank:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel containing the TSV file from ranking hmmsearch hits.\nWhen\
      \ save_domtblout is set, the table also carries the target and profile lengths\n\
      and, for each of the three coordinate sets, the bounds of the match, the size\
      \ of the\nunion of the pair's domains, and the number of disjoint pieces it\
      \ falls into.\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(hmmrank) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.hmmrank.tsv.gz"
- seqfastas:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel containing subsets of sequences\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(fasta) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.fa.gz"
- domain_summary:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel containing hmmsearch's per-domain hit table, only present\
      \ when save_domtblout is true\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(domtbl) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.domtbl.gz"
authors:
- "@erikrikarddaniel"
maintainers:
- "@erikrikarddaniel"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/hmmer/hmmsearch@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/hmmer/formattsv@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/duckdb/table2parquet@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/hmmer/hmmrank@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/seqtk/subseq@0.0.0-6d1763b"
